name: ModelVariant671_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant671_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to 32 blooms open in turn at a model joint, each a spinning square with a cone of Gouraud-shaded petals, and each spawns a ring of sixteen fading bands round a centre sprite); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs three texture images and seeds the blooms from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame, activating a bloom every 30 frames, and returns 3 once after frame 150, 4 while a bloom or ring is live, 2 once all are inactive and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-688 and 755 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
